question: How much does PM-KISAN pay per year and in how many instalments?
answer: Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 every four months, paid by Direct Benefit Transfer.

question: I paid income tax last year. Can I still get PM-KISAN?
answer: No. Anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year is excluded.

question: Are retired government employees excluded from PM-KISAN?
answer: Serving and retired officers and employees of central/state government departments and PSUs are excluded, except Multi-Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees.

question: What pension amount disqualifies someone from PM-KISAN?
answer: A monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding MTS / Class IV / Group D pensioners).

question: What documents are needed to register for PM-KISAN?
answer: Aadhaar card, landholding papers, and a savings bank account.

question: What is the minimum size of a house built under PMAY-G?
answer: 25 square metres, including a dedicated area for hygienic cooking.

question: How much toilet assistance is available to a PMAY-G beneficiary?
answer: Up to Rs. 12,000 for toilet construction, through convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin.

question: Does owning a refrigerator affect PMAY-G eligibility?
answer: Yes. Owning a refrigerator is one of the 13 automatic exclusion parameters.

question: What is the annual premium for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana?
answer: Rs. 20 per annum per member, auto-debited from the bank or post office account on or before 1st June.

question: At what age does PMSBY accident cover end?
answer: On attaining age 70 (age nearer birthday).

question: What age group can join Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana?
answer: Account holders of participating banks or post offices aged 18 to 50.

question: Under PMMVY, when is a benefit paid for a second child?
answer: Rs. 6,000 in one instalment after birth, only if the second child is a girl.

question: How much is the LPG connection benefit under Ujjwala?
answer: Rs. 1,600 for a 14.2 kg cylinder connection or Rs. 1,150 for a 5 kg cylinder, plus a free first refill and stove.

question: Can a man apply for an Ujjwala LPG connection?
answer: No. Only an adult woman of a poor household may apply; male members cannot.

question: What overdraft can a Jan Dhan account holder get?
answer: Up to Rs. 10,000 (raised from Rs. 5,000).

question: What accident insurance comes with a Jan Dhan RuPay card?
answer: Rs. 2 lakh accident cover (Rs. 1 lakh for accounts opened before 28.08.2018).

question: What loan range does Stand-Up India facilitate?
answer: Composite bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for greenfield enterprises.

question: Can a man from the general category get a Stand-Up India loan?
answer: No. A male applicant must belong to the SC or ST category; otherwise the borrower must be a woman.

question: What monthly stipend does a hosteller in a professional course get under the Post Matric Scholarship for ST students?
answer: Rs. 1,200 per month (Rs. 12,000 annually) for hostellers in professional courses.

question: What extra allowance do disabled students get under the ST post-matric scholarship?
answer: An additional Rs. 800 per month (Rs. 9,600 annually) for hostellers and Rs. 600 per month (Rs. 7,200 annually) for day scholars.

question: How much is the Old Age Samman Allowance in Haryana and what is the income limit?
answer: Rs. 3,000 per month for those aged 60 or above, with household income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.

question: How are PMAY-G beneficiaries identified?
answer: From housing deprivation data (SECC-based lists and the Awaas+ survey), verified by the Gram Sabha — beneficiaries do not apply directly.

question: I am 45 and have a bank account. Which insurance schemes can I join?
answer: PMJJBY (life cover, ages 18-50) and PMSBY (accident cover, Rs. 20 per year). Atal Pension Yojana would not accept a new subscriber above 40.

question: Which schemes in your documents are only for women or give women priority?
answer: Ujjwala (only an adult woman may apply), PMMVY (pregnant and lactating mothers), and Stand-Up India (at least one woman borrower per bank branch).

question: What support is available specifically for Scheduled Tribe students?
answer: The Post Matric Scholarship for ST students, with stipends from Rs. 230 to Rs. 1,200 per month depending on course and hosteller status, plus a disability allowance.

question: Compare the scholarships available to SC and ST students.
answer: SC students have the Post Matric Scholarship with a Rs. 2.5 lakh parental income limit; ST students have a separate Post Matric Scholarship under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs with course-wise stipends. NMMSS is a separate merit scholarship with a Rs. 3.5 lakh income limit.

question: Which schemes help a poor rural family that is building a house?
answer: PMAY-G provides Rs. 1.20-1.30 lakh, with convergence support: up to Rs. 12,000 for a toilet under SBM-G, MGNREGA wage employment, and an LPG connection under Ujjwala.

question: What schemes support a farmer beyond direct income support?
answer: Kisan Credit Card provides subsidised credit at an effective 4%, and PMFBY provides crop insurance against natural disasters, pests and disease, alongside PM-KISAN income support.

question: Which schemes require Aadhaar?
answer: Aadhaar is required for PM-KISAN (with mandatory eKYC), PMAY-G, Ujjwala (except Assam and Meghalaya) and Jan Dhan account opening.

question: What is available to a senior citizen with no income?
answer: In Haryana, the Old Age Samman Allowance pays Rs. 3,000 per month to those 60 or above with household income under Rs. 3 lakh. Atal Pension Yojana is for enrolment between ages 18 and 40, so it would not be open to a new applicant at that age.

question: Which schemes exclude income-tax payers?
answer: PM-KISAN excludes anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year; Atal Pension Yojana is for those who are not income-tax payees; PMAY-G automatically excludes income-tax and professional-tax payers.

question: आयुष्मान भारत में एक परिवार को हर साल कितने का इलाज मुफ्त मिलता है?
answer: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5,00,000 तक का कैशलेस इलाज (द्वितीयक और तृतीयक अस्पताल में भर्ती के लिए)।

question: उज्ज्वला योजना में गैस कनेक्शन के लिए कौन आवेदन कर सकता है?
answer: गरीब परिवार की वयस्क महिला जिसके घर में पहले से LPG कनेक्शन नहीं है; पुरुष सदस्य आवेदन नहीं कर सकते।

question: जन धन खाते पर कितना ओवरड्राफ्ट मिल सकता है?
answer: ₹10,000 तक का ओवरड्राफ्ट।

question: अटल पेंशन योजना में कौन शामिल हो सकता है?
answer: 18 से 40 वर्ष की आयु के बचत खाताधारक जो आयकरदाता नहीं हैं, मुख्यतः असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिक।

question: हरियाणा में बुढ़ापा सम्मान भत्ता कितना मिलता है?
answer: 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु वालों को ₹3,000 प्रति माह, यदि वार्षिक आय ₹3,00,000 से अधिक न हो।

question: क्या आयकर देने वाला किसान पीएम-किसान का लाभ ले सकता है?
answer: नहीं। पिछले निर्धारण वर्ष में आयकर देने वाले व्यक्ति योजना से बाहर हैं।

question: If more than one member of a family is named in the land records, who receives the PM-KISAN benefit?
answer: The benefit goes to the bank account of the family member with the highest quantum of land holding.

question: From which PM-KISAN instalment does Aadhaar become compulsory?
answer: Aadhaar is compulsory for the release of the second instalment onwards; for the first instalment other prescribed identity documents may be accepted.

question: Who implements the SC post-matric scholarship in Gujarat?
answer: The Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare implements it in Gujarat; it is a centrally sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
